cards.ex_en: We waited for intelligence about the missing ship.
cards.ex_cn: 我们等待着关于失踪船只的消息。

cards.ex_en: He lit the fire with a little charcoal.
cards.ex_cn: 他用一点木炭把火点着了。

cards.ex_en: The cat began to creep toward the bird.
cards.ex_cn: 那只猫开始向小鸟悄悄爬去。

cards.ex_en: He stuck a knife into his girdle.
cards.ex_cn: 他把一把刀插进腰带里。

cards.ex_en: She stopped to inquire about the road.
cards.ex_cn: 她停下来打听路怎么走。

cards.ex_en: We could not guess the issue of the trial.
cards.ex_cn: 我们猜不出这场审判的结局。

cards.ex_en: He gave a small nod in acknowledgment.
cards.ex_cn: 他微微点头以示致意。

cards.ex_en: The dog served its master with great fidelity.
cards.ex_cn: 这条狗对主人无比忠诚。

cards.ex_en: This seat is reserved for the winner.
cards.ex_cn: 这个座位是留给获胜者的。

cards.ex_en: They dwell in a small hut by the sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他们住在海边一间小屋里。

cards.ex_en: He explained the doctrine to his new friend.
cards.ex_cn: 他向新朋友讲解这教义。

cards.ex_en: Please refrain from talking in the library.
cards.ex_cn: 请在图书馆里忍住别说话。

cards.ex_en: He charged the gun before the hunt.
cards.ex_cn: 打猎前他给枪装好了弹。

cards.ex_en: The cave stayed undiscovered for years.
cards.ex_cn: 那个山洞多年来一直没被发现。

cards.ex_en: The water rose up to our ankles.
cards.ex_cn: 水涨到了我们的脚踝。

cards.ex_en: They owed their lives to the brave man.
cards.ex_cn: 他们的命都是那个勇敢的人救的。

cards.ex_en: The continual rain kept us indoors.
cards.ex_cn: 接连不断的雨把我们困在屋里。

cards.ex_en: He was civil to every guest at the door.
cards.ex_cn: 他对门口的每位客人都彬彬有礼。

cards.ex_en: The town was shocked by his villainy.
cards.ex_cn: 全镇都被他的恶行震惊了。

cards.ex_en: The thief was led to the gallows.
cards.ex_cn: 那个小偷被带上了绞刑架。

cards.ex_en: Seizing the rope, he climbed up fast.
cards.ex_cn: 他一把抓住绳子，飞快地爬了上去。

cards.ex_en: They won the game by a clever stratagem.
cards.ex_cn: 他们靠一个巧妙的计谋赢了这局。

cards.ex_en: The two sides met for a short parley.
cards.ex_cn: 双方进行了一次简短的谈判。

cards.ex_en: The prisoner was held in heavy irons.
cards.ex_cn: 那名囚犯被戴上沉重的镣铐。

cards.ex_en: The survivors reached the shore at dawn.
cards.ex_cn: 幸存者们在黎明时分到达岸边。

cards.ex_en: The prior welcomed us into the old church.
cards.ex_cn: 修道院院长把我们迎进古老的教堂。

cards.ex_en: He paid the merchant with bills of exchange.
cards.ex_cn: 他用汇票付给了那个商人。

cards.ex_en: The horses gallop across the wide field.
cards.ex_cn: 马儿在宽阔的田野上飞奔。

cards.ex_en: The colonel led his men into the town.
cards.ex_cn: 上校带领手下进了城。

cards.ex_en: He had a competent knowledge of the sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他对大海有足够的了解。

cards.ex_en: Men of poor fortunes often go to sea.
cards.ex_cn: 境遇困窘的人常常去出海谋生。

cards.ex_en: The aspiring boy dreamed of a great voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 这个有抱负的男孩梦想着一次伟大的航行。

cards.ex_en: Such bold undertakings need much courage.
cards.ex_cn: 这样大胆的行动需要很大的勇气。

cards.ex_en: He gained great riches from his trade.
cards.ex_cn: 他从生意中获得了巨大的财富。

cards.ex_en: The rich often suffer from strange distempers.
cards.ex_cn: 富人常常患上奇怪的疾病。

cards.ex_en: His extravagances soon spent all his money.
cards.ex_cn: 他的挥霍很快就花光了所有的钱。

cards.ex_en: The town offered few diversions in winter.
cards.ex_cn: 这个小镇在冬天几乎没什么消遣。

cards.ex_en: A quiet life seemed very desirable to him.
cards.ex_cn: 平静的生活在他看来非常值得追求。

cards.ex_en: The enraged bull rushed at the fence.
cards.ex_cn: 那头狂怒的公牛朝栅栏冲去。

cards.ex_en: She gave her son an affectionate hug.
cards.ex_cn: 她给了儿子一个充满爱意的拥抱。

cards.ex_en: His friends could not prevail on him to stay.
cards.ex_cn: 朋友们没能说服他留下来。

cards.ex_en: His words turned out to be strangely prophetic.
cards.ex_cn: 他的话后来竟奇怪地应验了。

cards.ex_en: He followed his own inclinations and left home.
cards.ex_cn: 他顺着自己的意愿离开了家。

cards.ex_en: She was inexpressibly happy to see them.
cards.ex_cn: 见到他们，她高兴得难以言表。
